findings.problem: The Bellarmine reference links to https://www.ecatholic2000.com/bellarmine/commentary.shtml, which returns HTTP 404 for both HEAD and a normal GET (the response explicitly says the URL was not found). The converter faithfully reproduces this invalid source URL, so readers cannot follow the supplied reference for Bellarmine’s Psalm 136 and 144 arguments. The registered historical-text artifact instead names https://www.ecatholic2000.com/bellarmine/commentary-on-psalms.shtml, verified with HTTP 200 and identified as the same O’Sullivan 1866 translation. Evidence: .scratch/proper-production-2026-10-05/web-review-v9-0000/bellarmine-get-headers.txt, bellarmine-get.html, bellarmine-correct-headers.txt, and review-evidence.json.
findings.required_result: Correct the URL in the canonical study source to the verified registered work URL, preserving its exact Psalm loci and edition attribution; regenerate the dependent reviewed artifacts and canonical web conversion through the workflow. The resulting reader link must open the intended Bellarmine commentary successfully; do not patch generated Markdown independently.
